create_wav2vec2_config: create a Wav2Vec2Config instance with default settings for the facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h model
configure_wav2vec2_layers: configure Wav2Vec2Config with custom conv_dim, conv_stride, and conv_kernel for the feature encoder
validate_wav2vec2_architecture: validate Wav2Vec2Config convolutional layer dimensions match with validate_architecture method
compute_inputs_to_logits_ratio: compute the inputs_to_logits_ratio property from Wav2Vec2Config conv_stride tuple
customize_wav2vec2_spec_augment: customize Wav2Vec2Config with apply_spec_augment, mask_time_prob, and mask_feature_prob for data augmentation
